inputs.name: opensearch_version
inputs.description: OpenSearch 3.x release to install, such as "3.9.0". Raising it upgrades OpenSearch in place.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password for OpenSearch's admin user, set when OpenSearch first installs. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: cluster_name
inputs.description: cluster.name. Changing it on a node with data makes OpenSearch refuse to start, since the data belongs to the old cluster.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: IP address OpenSearch listens on, its network.host. "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: http_port
inputs.description: Port of the REST API, its http.port.

inputs.name: heap_size
inputs.description: JVM heap, set as both -Xms and -Xmx, such as "512m" or "4g". Half the host's memory is the usual choice, up to about 31g.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: More opensearch.yml settings, such as { "indices.query.bool.max_clause_count" = "4096" }. Changing them restarts OpenSearch.

inputs.name: tls_certificate
inputs.description: PEM certificate for OpenSearch's REST and transport layers, in place of the demo one. Set it with tls_private_key and tls_ca_certificate.

inputs.name: tls_ca_certificate
inputs.description: PEM certificate of the CA that signed tls_certificate.

inputs.name: tls_private_key
inputs.description: PKCS#8 PEM private key of tls_certificate. Pass it at run time; it never reaches state or the plan.
